items.name: c-color-picker-1
items.title: Inline color panel
items.description: Saturation area, hue and opacity sliders, format fields and preset swatches rendered in place.
items.descriptionLong: Inline color panel. Built by composing Card, Color Picker. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-2
items.title: Popover picker
items.description: Outline trigger in a labelled field that opens the full picker with an eye dropper and format fields.
items.descriptionLong: Popover picker. Built by composing Color Picker, Field. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-3
items.title: Color input
items.description: Typable field that reads hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() or a CSS name, with a swatch that opens the picker.
items.descriptionLong: Color input. Built by composing Color Picker, Field. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-3 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-4
items.title: Opacity
items.description: A banner overlay with an opacity slider and field, written as rgb() with alpha.
items.descriptionLong: Opacity. Built by composing Card, Color Picker, Field. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-4 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-5
items.title: Preset swatches
items.description: Round label colors to pick from, a plus that opens the full picker, and a live label preview.
items.descriptionLong: Preset swatches. Built by composing Badge, Card, Color Picker, Field, Input. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-5 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-6
items.title: OKLCH theme token
items.description: Lightness, chroma and hue sliders for a --primary token, with a live Button and Badge preview.
items.descriptionLong: OKLCH theme token. Built by composing Badge, Button, Card, Checkbox, Color Picker and 2 more. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-6 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-7
items.title: Format converter
items.description: One color as HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB and OKLCH, each with a copy button.
items.descriptionLong: Format converter. Built by composing Card, Color Picker. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-7 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-8
items.title: Hue wheel
items.description: A hue ring around a saturation and brightness square, with HEX, RGB and HSL fields.
items.descriptionLong: Hue wheel. Built by composing Card, Color Picker. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-8 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-color-picker-9
items.title: Recent colors
items.description: Each pick is saved to a Recent row once a drag is released, not on every move.
items.descriptionLong: Recent colors. Built by composing Color Picker, Field. A free, open source shadcn color picker example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-color-picker-9 and edit as your own code.

items.title: Text and highlight colors

items.name: c-color-picker-11
items.title: Channel sliders
items.description: Red, green, blue and opacity sliders with numeric fields, each track redrawn from the others.

items.description: Fill, stroke and shadow rows that open a compact picker with vertical hue and opacity tracks.
